data.name: Watery Summons
data.description: A wave warden can summon allies once per day as a full-round action. This functions as summon nature's ally %1, except it can only be used to summon creatures with the aquatic or water subtypes. The warden's caster level is %2.|3+(RangerLVL-8)/3|RangerLVL
